manifest.release_notes:
SwiftEdge 1.3.9
- A sale now survives a moment when the server does not answer. If a tap (add an item, send to the kitchen, print the bill, take a payment) gets no answer, the till asks again by itself for up to about 12 seconds, and the server makes sure nothing is done twice. If it still cannot, the till says "The system did not answer. Please tap that again." Tested by restarting every web worker eleven times in the middle of 60 taps on the real order screen: every tap landed exactly once.
- Faster on older computers: every page and tap no longer waits for a new database connection. On a 2011 Core i5 a page now takes about 40 to 50 ms instead of 110 to 230 ms, and the server handles about three times as many requests a second at the busiest times.
- Windows: the web workers no longer restart by themselves during the day (all at once, which showed "502" on every till for a few seconds on a busy day), and the web server no longer treats a restarting worker as dead for ten seconds. This part is in the Windows service program, which updates do not replace: a server installed before 1.3.9 gets it by running update-service.cmd once from C:\SwiftEdge\current\windows-service (the steps are in README.txt there). Without it everything still works as before, but the other improvements in this release help less during a restart.
- Support: SwiftEdge support can now install a signed update or restart SwiftEdge on this server from their dashboard (it only ever installs updates signed by SwiftEdge, makes a backup first, goes back by itself if the check fails, and never restarts while a shift is open unless they tick "even if a shift is open"). Every such request is written to the audit log, and the owner can switch it off in Settings ("Let SwiftEdge support install an update or restart SwiftEdge ..."). The dashboard also shows how many times tills had to ask again today.
- Tested: a simulated busy day of 400 customers (3 waiters, a cashier, the kitchen screen, two network printers) on an old two-core computer: every customer was served and paid, the takings matched the bills to the cent, and every receipt and kitchen ticket printed, including after a printer was switched off for a while.

SwiftEdge 1.3.8
- Faster start on older computers: the back-office screens now load when you open them, so the first download is about a third of the size. The till, sign-in and menu screens are unchanged.
- An old browser now shows a clear message ("This browser is too old. Update Microsoft Edge or install Google Chrome") instead of a blank page.
- Printing: a receipt for a network printer that was briefly off is now retried three times instead of being lost.
- USB printers: if Windows did not set a plugged-in USB printer up, Admin > Printer helpers shows it with a Set up button. The helper adds the printer using the driver that comes with Windows.
- Support: SwiftEdge can ask this computer for a diagnostics report (errors, printers, memory) and to check for updates, and the dashboard shows the last print error and each till's browser version. Nothing is installed or changed this way, and no names, amounts or customer details are sent.
- Small computers: new installs set the number of web workers and the database memory from the computer's memory.

SwiftEdge 1.3.7
- Counter: the cashier chooses VAT for each line or for the whole sale: price includes VAT, add VAT on top, or no VAT. Every change is recorded with the cashier's name, and the receipt shows it.
- Receipts: the address can have several lines (building, street, town); several phone numbers (separate them with commas).
- M-Pesa: choose Till or Paybill in Settings, Business; a Paybill prints with its account number ("Pay by M-Pesa Paybill: 247247 Acc: SHOP").
- Fix (Windows): updates, M-Pesa, eTIMS and activation no longer fail with "unable to get local issuer certificate" on a fresh PC.
- Installer: clearer router advice (fixed IP, and the router's DNS pointing at this server).

SwiftEdge 1.3.6
- Printer helpers: the Windows and Linux helper installers can be downloaded on a new install (Admin, Printer helpers), so USB printers can be connected.
- Windows: uninstalling after an update removes every program link cleanly.

SwiftEdge 1.3.5
- Credit book: regulars who pay later, SMS reminders, statements.
- Wholesale prices for resellers and bulk buyers.
- Tills keep selling when the server is off; M-Pesa codes are checked after.
- Lay-by: goods set aside while a customer pays in instalments.
- Staff clock-in and clock-out, and staff hours.
- Takeaway and delivery orders; open tabs on the floor.
- Table reservations.
- Detailed error reports and a five-minute heartbeat to SwiftEdge (after activation).
- Fixes: menu page with a new business, price check, quick taps on a dish, recovery sheet commands on Windows.
- Counter: quick scans are added in turn, none lost.
- Windows: the server opens its own address (no certificate warning); installer fixes from the first real install.
